A [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''son''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaurick]]'s [[Gaurick's mufti|ruling]] [[mufti]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the mufti's son was implicated in a series of unsanctioned beheadings, the mufti sought outsider help.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Disconnect}}</ref>
